description: This file contains interface definitions, constants, and a data class related to stream batching tests within the Orleans project. It includes a grain interface 'IStreamBatchingTestConsumerGrain', a constants class 'StreamBatchingTestConst', and a serializable data class 'ConsumptionReport'.
